questions.question: Show the whole file or log anyway?

options.label: Only what matters (Recommended)
options.description: I find the lines that matter with a search or a line range and show only those; they serve the request without all of it staying in the conversation.

options.label: Yes
options.description: I show all of it; it stays in the conversation, and every turn re-reads it.

options.label: No
options.description: I show nothing of the file or log.
